title: Accounts Assistant
description:
CMA Recruitment is delighted to be supporting our Bournemouth, Dorset client. This organisation boasts a strong market presence and a collaborative culture committed to sustainable growth and innovation. As part of a dynamic and supportive team, you will contribute to a forward-thinking environment that values integrity, continuous improvement, and employee well-being. The role offers a chance to develop your finance expertise and support a company with ambitious growth plans and a recognised commitment to sustainability.

What will the Accounts Payable Assistant role involve?
- Managing the purchase ledger with efficiency, ensuring invoices and credit notes are accurately processed and posted
- Building strong relationships with suppliers, resolving queries, and maintaining up-to-date supplier records
- Processing supplier payments, monitoring balances, and maximising settlement discounts in line with payment terms
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating aged or outstanding items to maintain ledger accuracy
- Supporting month-end processes including accruals, journal entries, and audit activities, while continuously enhancing processes and controls

Suitable Candidate for the Accounts Payable Assistant vacancy:
- Experience in an accounts payable or purchase ledger environment, with a good understanding of invoice processing
- Familiarity with SAP S/4 HANA or similar ERP systems is desirable
- Attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
- Strong communication skills and a professional approach when interacting with stakeholders
- Proactive problem-solving skills, with a focus on maintaining accuracy and efficiency in financial processes

Additional benefits and information for the role of Accounts Payable Assistant:
- A supportive, inclusive work environment with opportunities for professional growth
- Hybrid working model encouraging flexibility and work-life balance
- Access to various employee perks, including wellness initiatives and social events
- Opportunities for training, development, and career progression
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Position: Accounts Assistant
Job ID: (phone number removed)
Location: Poundbury, Dorset
Rate/Salary: £33,000 per annum
Type: Permanent / Full Time

HSB Technical Ltd is a specialist recruiter within the Power & Propulsion, Shipbuilding, Maritime Shipping, Energy, Subsea and Fire & Security sectors.

The job description below outlines the position of Accounts Assistant.

Overview:

Our client is looking for an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their finance team based in Poundbury.

The successful candidate will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, with responsibilities covering both purchase and sales ledger activities, invoice processing, supplier payments, account reconciliations and general financial administration.

This is a varied finance role, offering the opportunity to work closely with the wider finance team, project managers, suppliers and customers to ensure accurate financial records and efficient financial processes.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant position, with a good understanding of purchase and sales ledger processes. Experience using Sage accounting software and Microsoft Excel would be particularly beneficial.

Our client is looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger, Sales Ledger or similar finance role.
- Experience processing purchase invoices and customer sales invoices.
- Experience reconciling supplier accounts and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Working knowledge of Sage Accounts or Sage 200.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.
- The ability to manage workloads, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- The ability to work independently as well as effectively within a finance team.
- A proactive approach to resolving invoice queries and financial discrepancies.

Duties and Responsibilities
Purchase Ledger
- Receive, review and process supplier invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Match purchase invoices against purchase orders, goods received notes (GRNs) and supporting documentation.
- Obtain the appropriate authorisation for invoices where required.
- Process approved supplier invoices using Sage accounting software.
- Resolve invoice queries with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Prepare supplier payment runs and reconcile supplier accounts to ensure records remain accurate and up to date.

Financial Processing
- Process and reconcile company credit card transactions.
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
- Assist with month-end procedures and account reconciliations.

Sales Ledger Support
- Prepare and raise customer sales invoices.
- Work alongside Project Managers to ensure purchase orders are received promptly to avoid unnecessary delays to invoicing.
- Support receipt allocation and customer account administration.
- Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue accounts.
- Maintain accurate sales ledger records.

General Finance Support
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Assist with a variety of finance and administrative tasks as directed by the Finance team.
- Support the continuous improvement of finance processes and controls.
- Provide ad-hoc reporting and administrative assistance when required.
- Contribute to financial controls, audit activities and process improvement initiatives.

The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant to join an established organisation in a varied and hands-on finance position.

The role offers a starting salary of £33,000 per annum and the opportunity to develop your experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger and wider financial operations.

Candidates with previous experience using Sage and handling both purchase and sales ledger responsibilities are particularly encouraged to apply.

title: Credit Controller
description:
CMA Recruitment Group is working with an established professional services organisation in Bournemouth, Dorset to recruit a Credit Controller. This is a varied role combining credit control and billing, with plenty of interaction across the wider business. The successful candidate will take responsibility for outstanding debt, resolve client account queries and work closely with internal stakeholders to support an efficient billing and collection process.
What will the Credit Controller role involve?
- Manage outstanding debt, contacting clients by telephone, email and letter to secure payment
- Monitor aged debt and work with internal teams to resolve queries delaying collection
- Prepare client bills and process billing amendments and credit notes
- Provide clients with copy invoices, statements and account information
- Process card payments and maintain accurate account records
- Review aged debt and WIP with internal stakeholders
- Support the wider Finance team with account reconciliations, transfers and other revenue-related queries

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Controller vacancy:
- Previous credit control, billing or accounts receivable experience
- Strong communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner
- highly desirable to have business to consumer credit control experience
- Organised approach with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines
- Comfortable building relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

Additional benefits and information for the role of credit control:
- 37.5 hours week (9:00am - 5:30pm Monday-Friday)
- Salary will be dependent on experience
- Central Bournemouth location, with great transport links
- Parking provided
- Hybrid working, 2 days a week from home after initial training period

title: Finance Assistant
description:
CMA Recruitment Group is delighted to be partnering with a long-established and highly respected local business to recruit a Progressive Finance Assistant. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who has already gained experience within their first one or two finance roles and is now looking to firmly establish themselves within a progressive finance function, building a long-term career with clear development opportunities.

The business is currently focused on succession planning and developing talent from within. As a result, this role offers genuine scope to broaden your responsibilities over time, learn more advanced areas of finance and progress into a more senior position. For the right individual, there is no predefined ceiling on growth and development, making this an ideal opportunity for an ambitious finance professional eager to continue learning and advancing their career. This position is full-time and office based.

What will the Finance Assistant role involve?
- Processing sales ledger transactions, cash receipts and associated reconciliations.
- Maintaining and reconciling company credit card and petty cash records.
- Assisting with purchase ledger activities during peak periods
- Bank reconciliations
- Assist with month end processes
- Production of management accounts as your experience within the business develops
- Contributing to finance process improvements and future digitalisation projects
- Work extremely closely with the financial controller, who will provide ongoing training and mentorship as your role grows within the business

Suitable Candidate for the Finance Assistant vacancy:
- Ideally studying towards AAT Level 3 or Level 4 qualified, or further studies such as ACCA/ACA/CIMA or qualified by experience
- Previous finance experience gained with a solid understand of double entry
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail
- A genuine desire to develop a long-term career within finance and take on increasing responsibility
- Confident communicator with the ability to build effective relationships across the business
Comfortable working within a collaborative, office-based environment

Additional benefits and information for the Finance Assistant vacancy:
- Salary of £28,000-£32,000 per annum depending on experience and qualifications.
- Full study support available where applicable.
- Full-time office-based position.
- Outstanding long-term career progression opportunities within a stable and successful local business
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced finance leaders and gain exposure to wider areas of the finance function

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining an established and successful organisation with a varied portfolio. Working from attractive offices near Christchurch, you will be part of a welcoming finance team that supports several different areas of the wider organisation.
Your new role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will manage the everyday purchase ledger process and help ensure supplier accounts remain accurate and up to date. This will include entering and coding invoices and credit notes, checking documentation processed through automated software and completing supplier statement reconciliations.
You will investigate invoice discrepancies, respond to supplier queries and work closely with colleagues across the organisation to resolve any issues. You will also assist with regular payment runs, arrange additional electronic payments when needed and provide general support to the wider finance team.

What you'll need to succeed
You will have previous purchase ledger or accounts payable experience and be confident managing a busy workload accurately. A practical knowledge of VAT is important, alongside strong attention to detail and good communication skills. You will be comfortable using accounting software and Excel. A dependable, organised and team-focused approach will be key.

What you'll get in return
You will receive a salary of 26,000- 29,000 depending on experience, 22 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a 6% employer pension contribution. Free on-site parking is available, and you will work in a pleasant office environment as part of a supportive finance team. This is a fully office-based position with no hybrid working.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
